steps.description:
A budget covers one date range and is named after it. Overlapping budgets are allowed but warn on save, because the budget reports show one budget at a time and spending would be split between them.

Set a Start Date to continue.
steps.label: The Period
steps.title: The Period

steps.description:
One line per Expense Type, with what you plan to spend. Add All Expense Types in the grid menu starts you from the full list. Actuals are matched to a line by Expense Type, so a type you leave out is not tracked, and a parent type already includes its children, so budgeting both counts that spending twice.

Add at least one line to continue.
steps.label: Expense Lines
steps.title: Expense Lines

steps.description: Summed from the lines as you type them. Once the budget is saved, a Status section appears above it with the actual spend, the percent used and what is left.
steps.label: Total Budgeted
steps.title: Total Budgeted
